calibration_rulings.ruling: A: each body opens with the page's own name as its subject — «سوق القیصریہ (یعنی القیصریہ کا بازار) خلیجی خطے کے …», «“ارض الحضارات” (تہذیبوں کی سرزمین) نامی ثقافتی گاؤں اور نمائش …». The reader passed both openings (his item 24 is on the title, not on the body). B, the literal fragment, stays on record. Logged as a source defect (form).
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader, not machine-read: the supplied subject is the page's title key byte for byte; nothing but the name and the gloss the rulings owe is added.

calibration_rulings.title: Homographs and the helmet: «الظفر», «الجفر», «فوجی خود».
calibration_rulings.binds: dhafar-museum::title, body; najim-museum::summary, body, area; dar-alturath::body (change 0). Every later war helmet.
calibration_rulings.ruling: (1) «الظفر» and (2) «الجفر»: A, no fence. No ruling fences a family name (N122, whose open question to the owner now names «الظفر» too); «جفر» is no common Urdu word, so N73 (2) does not reach «الجفر». The reader read both as names without a remark. (3) THE HELMET: B, «جنگی خود», on the reader: he read «فوجی خود» as 'the military themselves' (item 4, moderate), the case stage 4 named for B. «جنگی خود» is the dictionary's collocation (rekhta's helmet page) and «جنگی» is never a noun 'soldier'. C, the loan «ہیلمٹ», stays refused (P16: a native word exists). Change 0. ‖ ENTERED ON APPLY (2026-10-14) AS AN OWNER DECISION, OPEN (the judge file gives this entry the status "ruled"; in the list for the owner, its decision 8 adds a name of this entry, item (1), to the open question of N122 (family names read as words), which this ruling cites; N122 itself is a ruling of b8 and is not amended here; it is entered with its open question stated, as b6 entered N93, N94 and N99, b7 entered N106 and N110 and b8 entered N122, N129 and N130). The wording ruled above is what the text carries until the owner answers; no leaf waits on the answer. THE QUESTION, as the list for the owner in the judge file words it (its note FOR THE OWNER, decision 8): «الظفر» joins N122's family-name homograph question. ‖ ENTERED ON APPLY (2026-10-14) AS AN OWNER DECISION, OPEN, FROM THE JUDGE'S ADDENDUM (the addendum to judge round 1, written after the proof pass on round 1 and the second blind reader, changes no string and no ruling; its list for the owner, section 6, holds what that reader added or sharpened and keeps round 1's list; its item 1 is the question this ruling concerns, and its section 2 note 6 asks that item (3) of this ruling be entered with the contest stated; entered with its question stated, as b8 entered N122, N129 and N130). The wording ruled above is what the text carries until the owner answers; no leaf waits on the answer. THE CONTEST, as the addendum words it (section 2, note 6): two readers of two read «خود» first as 'self' («فوجی خود», then «جنگی خود»); both recovered the helmet on a second look. THE CANDIDATES, as the addendum lists them (section 3, change 0): (a) «جنگی خود (آہنی ٹوپیاں)», reader 2's wording. It brings a meaning bracket after a common noun, a form no ruling has (P3c point 5 keeps two bracket forms, both for names). It would be the first such bracket on /ur/ and needs a ruling, not a batch edit. (b) the loan «ہیلمٹ», reader 1's bracket: refused under P16, since a native word exists. (c) a description such as «سر کی حفاظت کے لیے پہنے جانے والے جنگی خود» or «لوہے کی جنگی ٹوپیاں». The first is wordy and still says «خود». The second adds 'iron', which neither source says. (d) «کلاہ آہنی» (rekhta's definition word): literary, and it says 'iron' too. As the addendum rules there: «جنگی خود» stays, charged once more under dar-alturath nativeness. The candidates (a) to (d) go to the owner (section 6). The N139 (3) entry on apply states the contest. THE QUESTION, as the addendum words it (section 6, item 1): The helmet: two readers of two read «خود» first as 'self'. The options are the meaning bracket «جنگی خود (آہنی ٹوپیاں)» (a new form, needs a ruling), the loan «ہیلمٹ» (his P16 refuses it while a native word exists), or a description. The text keeps «جنگی خود» until he answers. ‖ ENTERED ON APPLY (2026-10-14), proof pass on round 1, note 5, and the judge's addendum, section 2 note 5, record only (no string moves): the candidate list of this entry in the judge file, which the termbase does not carry, labels candidate A "(in the text)", but the helmet it quotes, «فوجی خود», is withdrawn and no longer stands in the text (item (3) of the ruling takes B); the names it quotes, «صالح الظفر» and «الجفر», stay, as items (1) and (2) of the ruling take A; the label reads "(stage 4's text)", the smallest correction the addendum words (as b8 proof on round 2, note 6). The ruling above says what replaced it. The proof pass also notes that the evidence of this entry, which the termbase does not carry either, still quotes the replaced sentence in the present tense.
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader: a war helmet is «جنگی خود»; «فوجی خود» and «ہیلمٹ» are not written.
